hero.title: Small measures, made effortless.
hero.text: KitchenScaleCo began with a simple idea: the smallest measurements in a recipe deserve a tool that's just as considered. A pinch of spice, a scoop of coffee, a level spoon of baking powder — weighed right where you scoop.

mission.title: Make small, precise measuring effortless.
mission.p1: Most kitchen scales are built for big batches. Yet the ingredients that change a dish the most — spices, leavening, coffee, tea — are often measured in just a few grams. That's where guesswork creeps in.
mission.p2: We design tools that bring precision to those small amounts without adding steps, clutter or fuss. Scoop, read, add — and get back to cooking.
mission.imageAlt: Illustration of the Mini Spoon Scale on a kitchen counter

values.title: Three principles behind everything we make

design.title: Thoughtful design
design.text: Every detail should earn its place. We favour calm, simple forms that feel good in the hand and look at home on the counter.

useful.title: Everyday usefulness
useful.text: We make tools for real kitchens and busy mornings — things you reach for every day, not gadgets that disappear into a drawer.

honest.title: Honest information
honest.text: We only describe what we can stand behind. Where details are still being confirmed, we say so plainly.

why.title: The scale, right where you scoop
why.text: A measuring spoon with a built-in digital display brings the weight to the exact moment you need it.

oneStep.title: Scoop and read in one motion
oneStep.text: No separate scale, no balancing a bowl on the counter. Scoop your ingredient and the reading appears on the handle display.
oneStep.imageAlt: The Mini Spoon Scale seen at an angle, showing the handle display

small.title: Made for the small amounts
small.text: Spices, leavening, coffee grounds and loose-leaf tea are where a few grams matter most. A spoon scale is sized for exactly those moments.
small.imageAlt: Close-up of the spoon bowl filled with a small amount of spice

tidy.title: Less to wash, less to store
tidy.text: Use the tare function to zero between ingredients, then wash the detachable spoon head by hand when you're done. One compact tool instead of several.
tidy.imageAlt: The Mini Spoon Scale resting on its display stand
